title: Dinomaly: The Less Is More Philosophy in Multi-Class Unsupervised Anomaly Detection
mechanism: Normal-only feature reconstruction with a DINOv2 encoder, dropout noisy bottleneck, linear attention and loose reconstruction for a single multi-class model.
adaptation: One model across 5 sources x mono/multi/half-cut trained on clean pool cells; evaluate the map against inactive masks and crack masks dilated by 2 px; candidate prior channel for E1.
min_experiment: Train once; pixel AUROC / AU-PRO on test and F51 for inactive and crack-band; fusion with PF ensemble, kill if E1 inactive IoU gain < +0.03.
evidence: R: image AUROC 99.6 MVTec-AD, 98.7 VisA, 89.3 Real-IAD in multi-class setting.

alt_notes.adaptation: One model over 5 sources x mono/multi/half-cut on clean pool cells; evaluate the map against inactive and crack dilated by 2 px; prior channel for E1.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Benchmark AD track: train once, report pixel AUROC, AU-PRO, relF1@2 per class on CV and E1; for scores, same offline recall test as AnomalyDINO with kill at < 30% recovery.
